prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1207; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presented with scraping and a dented panel along the right rear quarter, with paint transfer and a cracked tail lamp housing, consistent with a sideswipe while changing lanes. Most of the marks sit where the reported contact would have occurred, and nothing I inspected points to a different event. The bodywork plan calls for replacing the rear door skin, refinishing the adjacent panels, and swapping the lamp assembly, with labor hours that match the extent of the damage. The invoices reviewed show a single set of charges with no duplicated line items. The vehicle has no prior damage on file, and I found no signs of earlier repairs.
